mapper.select: SELECT m.moim_account_id, k.account_number, k.bank_name, k.balance, k.interest_rate, m.account_name FROM moim_accounts m INNER JOIN kb_accounts k ON m.kb_account_id = k.kb_account_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.account_status='ACTIVE'
SELECT m.moim_account_id, m.user_id, m.kb_account_id, m.account_status, m.account_name, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM moim_accounts m WHERE m.moim_account_id = #{moimAccountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moim_accounts ( moim_account_id, user_id, kb_account_id, account_status, account_name ) VALUES ( #{moimAccountId}, #{userId}, #{kbAccountId}, #{accountStatus}, #{accountName} )
mapper.select: SELECT moim_account_id, user_id, kb_account_id, account_status, account_name, created_at, updated_at FROM moim_accounts WHERE kb_account_id = #{kbAccountId} LIMIT 1

SELECT kb_account_id, account_number, bank_name, balance, interest_rate, account_type FROM kb_accounts k LEFT JOIN moim_accounts m ON k.kb_account_id = m.kb_account_id WHERE k.name = #{name} AND k.birthday = #{birthday} AND k.account_type = 'MOIM' AND ( m.kb_account_id IS NULL OR m.account_status = 'DEACTIVATED' )
